title: Build ML model on Synthetic Patient Data to Predict OSA Risk
summary: A student final-project notebook that trains a machine-learning model to predict obstructive sleep apnea risk from UK Biobank-style patient data. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic patient records (with conditional sampling for class balance) and SDV's run_diagnostic/evaluate_quality functions to validate the synthetic data's structure and fidelity.
